capabilities: Chat with multiple LLM providers, including local and CLI backends
Build multi-step workflows in a visual node editor
Index the vault locally and inject relevant chunks into prompts (RAG)
Let the model read, create, and propose edits to notes via function calling
Track and restore AI-made file changes with a diff view
disambiguation: Not a chat-only plugin; it also builds multi-step workflows and maintains a local RAG index, and Discord/Kakeratta chat is handled by the separate LLM Connect Hub plugin.
extras: Desktop only; mobile users are directed to Gemini Helper. Discord/Kakeratta integration was moved out into the separate LLM Connect Hub plugin, which migrates legacy settings on first connection. Edit history is in-memory and cleared on restart; Obsidian's built-in file recovery covers persistent version tracking. Live voice sessions bill provider API charges, and realtime audio may fail behind a required proxy. Forgetting an encryption password makes encrypted files unrecoverable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use external LLMs on notes, and single-provider AI plugins lock users into one model or service.

relations.evidence: Supply AI models, Chat, Base generation, and Workflow execution to the separate Dashboard Hub plugin
Supply API, CLI, and local models to the separate multi-provider Discussion Hub plugin
Connect to Discord and Kakeratta and use LLM Hub models and RAG
Install speech-popup and a microphone button appears above the send button
Models contributed by Gemini Helper and Local LLM Hub can participate in the same discussion

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Grok, or OpenCode
Local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, AnythingLLM, OpenCode)
CLI tool (Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI)
Tavily or Brave Search for external web search

summary: Multi-provider AI assistant for Obsidian with chat, a visual workflow builder, and local semantic search (RAG) over vault notes.
